summary: Backend-only testing for Ahmad Classes MVP. Wrote pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py) covering all 18 requested endpoints across auth, batches (list/get/create/purchase/user-batches), live class lifecycle (start/current/end -> auto-note), polls (create/current/vote/duplicate-reject/close), chat post+list, notes filters (subject/kind), quizzes (list/get/create/submit/scores), admin analytics, PDF upload+fetch via Emergent Object Storage, and Gemini 3 flash streaming AI chat. Result: 15/15 tests passed (100%). All flows work end-to-end including data-persistence GET verifications, mock purchase enrollment, streaming AI (verified content-type text/plain and first-byte flow), and object-storage round-trip. No critical or minor backend issues discovered.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 700 lines threshold marginally-ok (743). Consider splitting into modules (auth, batches, live, polls, quizzes, notes, ai) if it grows further.
GET /api/live/current and /api/polls/current return raw None (JSON null) when empty; frontend must handle null explicitly.

Admin endpoints (POST /api/batches, /api/quizzes, /api/live/start, /api/polls, /api/polls/{id}/close) have NO authentication guard — any client can call them. Not required for MVP but a security consideration.
Poll double-vote uses HTTP 400; a 409 Conflict would be more idiomatic (non-blocking).
purchase_batch does not verify the user exists; addToSet on a missing user is a silent no-op (works because seed users are always created via login first, but worth validating).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed users, batches, polls, quizzes, notes, chat messages, live classes, quiz submissions, and one uploaded PDF via Emergent Object Storage on every run. Data is left in DB by design (backend has no bulk-delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` (xdist), so test classes are pinned to workers — do not share state across TestX classes via module attributes; use session-scoped fixtures in conftest.py (see student_user fixture pattern). Base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env.
